summary.zh: 综合比较模型能力、价格、响应速度和上下文，适合选型前横向了解。
summary.en: Compare model capability, price, speed and context before choosing a model.

limits.zh: 不同指标分别计算；以原站方法和实时结果为准。
limits.en: Each metric has its own methodology. Read the live results and methodology at the source.

summary.zh: 查看独立基准任务的模型表现，并了解测试方法。
summary.en: Explore independent model benchmarks and their methodology.

limits.zh: 不同代际与任务集不直接合并，原站可能需要加载脚本。
limits.en: Benchmark generations and task sets are distinct. The source site may require JavaScript.

summary.zh: 聚焦模型修改代码与多语言编程任务的表现。
summary.en: Compare model performance on code editing and polyglot programming tasks.

limits.zh: 成绩基于 Aider 的测试方式与配置，不代表所有 Agent 场景。
limits.en: Scores use Aider-specific tests and settings and do not represent every agent workflow.

summary.zh: 以用户偏好对战为特色，查看文本、视觉、网页开发等不同榜单。
summary.en: Explore preference-based rankings for text, vision and web development.

limits.zh: 偏好排名与标准化任务分数含义不同，请查看具体子榜。
limits.en: Preference rankings differ from task benchmark scores. Check the individual leaderboard.

summary.zh: 围绕真实软件仓库问题，查看编程 Agent 的任务解决表现。
summary.en: Compare coding agents on real software repository issues.

limits.zh: 结果同时受模型、Agent 工具和测试环境影响；注意 Verified 等分组。
limits.en: Results depend on the model, agent tools and environment. Check groups such as Verified.

summary.zh: 查看 OpenCode 提供的免费模型与体验活动，从官方入口了解如何使用。
summary.en: Find free models and trial offers provided through OpenCode.

limits.zh: 部分模型限时免费；其他模型可能收费，使用范围及限流以官方说明为准。
limits.en: Only selected models are temporarily free. Other models may be paid; check official access rules and limits.

summary.zh: 发现免费模型和免费路由，适合了解开源模型与轻量体验。
summary.en: Discover free models and routing options for lightweight experimentation.

limits.zh: 免费模型有请求限制和供给限制；账号额度与政策可能变化。
limits.en: Free models have request and availability limits. Account allowances and policies can change.

summary.zh: 在浏览器体验 Gemini 与多模态开发工具，查看可用的免费层。
summary.en: Try Gemini and multimodal development tools in a browser and explore free-tier access.

limits.zh: 模型、地区、账号和功能影响可用额度；付费服务单独计费。
limits.en: Availability depends on the model, region, account and feature. Paid services are billed separately.

summary.zh: 体验 NVIDIA 托管的模型演示与开发 API 试用入口。
summary.en: Explore hosted model demos and developer API trials from NVIDIA.

limits.zh: 试用受账号、可用额度和试用条款限制，不代表永久免费生产服务。
limits.en: Trials depend on account eligibility, available credits and trial terms; production use is separate.
